package com.truetileplayerindicators;

import lombok.Getter;

enum PlayerType
{
	OWN("own"),
	PARTY("party"),
	FRIENDS("friends"),
	FRIENDS_CHAT("friendsChat"),
	TEAM("team"),
	CLAN("clan"),
	OTHERS("others");

	@Getter
	private final String key;

	PlayerType(String key)
	{
		this.key = key;
	}
}
